text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan meets former Israeli prime minister Shimon Peres.
- Morocco plans to reinforce diplomatic ties with Asian, African and South American partners to expand trade cooperation.
- Ministerial delegation visits Western Sahara to tackle unemployment and promote economy.
- Interior ministry anti-narcotics squad dismantles drug network in Tangier.
- Half a million Moroccan expatriates passed through Spain to reach Europe after spending holidays at home.
- Morocco expects intense political activity with referendum on constitutional reform.
- Casablanca transport companies find it difficult to make profit.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj says economy is picking up, but deplores insufficient gain from privatisations after some operations were postponed.
